scope: 4096-square bucket fills, three sequential repetitions per case and binary. Headless release executables, no simultaneous compilation or other benchmark. Plain is tolerance 0, edges disabled; initial UI settings are tolerance 12 with fill_edges enabled. The original baseline executable only adds the size parameter; the second baseline adds edge parameters to the same original production algorithm. Direct excludes history/UI/GPU; queued wall includes worker, history settlement and 1 ms polling sleeps, excludes display refresh. These are local measurements, not click-to-visible latency, confidence intervals or guaranteed speedups.
verification: Every benchmark checks all destination pixels, unchanged reference pixels and worker undo. Fixed 512/2048 gap/expansion cases check all pixels, reference and undo/redo. Full Verify.ps1: 905 normal and 914 all-feature Rust tests, 8 ignored explicit probes, both Clippy configurations, formatting, 36 Python tests, release build. New scalar oracles cover span connectivity, unique visits, tile-crossing blending, soft selection and cancellation.

before.advanced_scope: One direct fill repetition per size/source/expansion. Includes reference/mask construction and painting, excludes history setup/commit, undo/redo, verification and UI/GPU. Broken one-pixel wall, close-gap radius 1, signed square expansion. Exact destination/reference pixels and undo/redo checked. No worker latency or process peak claims.
before.scope: Supported 512/2048-square sparse, dense flat compatibility, dense tiled and dense tiled with 24 metadata/raster Full undo snapshots; history preparation outside timing. Direct fill includes reference preparation, excluding UI/GPU/history/result verification and total process memory. Worker maximum call includes publication/sliced history; worker wall includes 1 ms polling sleeps. Publication call contains damage and may also settle history within its remaining budget; settlement calls are later calls. Settlement peak is prepared patch payload capacity, excluding retained snapshots and total memory; history bytes estimate exclusive retained allocations, not RSS. Three sequential repetitions per source, size and workload; exact direct/worker/reference pixels and worker undo checked outside timing.

repeat_scope: The default-UI baseline was repeated after the overnight pause, immediately after the new UI run, to check the current comparison. The original UI baseline is retained separately. The plain baseline was measured before the pause. Final executable differs from timed after.exe only in explanatory benchmark report scope text and size-override validation (minimum 512, matching the established fixtures).
